# TDrive 3.0.8

This update improves iPhone video downloads and photo previews.

## Highlights

- **YouTube downloads on iPhone:** Compatible separate H.264 video and AAC audio streams are combined into an MP4 using AVFoundation, so downloaded videos include sound and play in TDrive. The iPhone offers only formats it can merge without transcoding. MP3 conversion still requires FFmpeg; M4A audio downloads remain available.
- **HEIC and HEIF previews:** These photos now open in TDrive on Apple devices. TDrive creates a JPEG preview for viewing while keeping the original HEIC/HEIF file unchanged for download.
